assumptions: Body boundaries from enumerateTests were left alone: they also feed LINT-006 and the test inventory, so the look-back window changed instead (smaller blast radius).

An annotation attaches through a run of comment lines, blank lines, and (Python) single-line decorators directly above the declaration. A multi-line decorator ends the run, so an annotation above one is not read and the test falls back to import inference (pre-annotation behaviour, never a false block).

An annotation above a describe() no longer reaches the first test inside it. The skill docs only show the annotation directly above the it(), and no test in canary's own suite relies on the describe form.

Second root cause, fixed in the same PR because the issue's measured case needs it: an annotated target is checked against comment-free body lines, because a JS body carries the next test's // @covers comment and that comment counted as a reference.
Python had the same floor bug (the body runs to the next def, comment included); the new window fixes it too and a pytest case is pinned.
